Claim.pendingBody: We have sent you a link to confirm your email address. Follow it and this Handle is yours.
Claim.linkExpiredBody: Links last an hour, and holds last a day — so this happens often. Your Handle is still held for you: ask for a new link below and you can finish claiming it.
Claim.linkSupersededBody: A newer link was sent, so this one no longer works — only the newest one does. Your Handle is still held for you. Use the most recent email, or ask for another link below.
Claim.unverifiedHeading: Confirm your email to sign in
Claim.unverifiedBody: This account has not been confirmed yet, so there is nothing to sign in to. Your Handle is still held for you — follow the link in your email, or ask for a new one below.
Claim.linkUnknownHeading: We could not read that link
Claim.linkUnknownBody: Either the link was cut in half by an email client, or the hold it belonged to ran out and the Handle went back into the pool. If your account is still waiting to be confirmed, asking for a new link below will reach it; if the hold has gone, pick a Handle again.
Claim.holdExpiredBody: A Handle is held for 24 hours while you confirm your email, and this one was not confirmed in time. It has gone back into the pool, so it may be free — or somebody else may have claimed it.
Claim.resendEmailLabel: The email address you signed up with
Claim.resendSent: If that address has an account waiting to be confirmed, a new link is on its way. It is the only one that will work from now on.
Claim.resendTooSoon: We can only send one link a minute. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
Claim.resendTooSoonOne: We can only send one link a minute. Try again in a second.
Claim.resendTooMany: That is as many links as we can send in an hour. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
Claim.resendTooManyOne: That is as many links as we can send in an hour. Try again in a minute.
Claim.resendInvalid: Enter the email address you signed up with.
Claim.resendFailed: We could not send a link just now. Try again in a moment.
Claim.verifiedBody: Your email is confirmed and this Handle is now yours for good.
Claim.signInInvalid: That email address and password do not match an account.
Claim.signInFailed: We could not sign you in just now. Try again in a moment.
